name: philippines_hotspot_split_v2_1

study.label: Compact Maguindanao / western Mindanao study box

split_policy: Even x-index cells with issue date < 2024-08-01 → train (≤2023) / validation (2024-01…03). Odd x-index cells OR dates ≥ 2024-08-01 → independent test (new geographic+temporal reserve). Previously inspected v1 holdout remains archived and is not reused as the final claim.
availability_assumption: Acquisition time treated as availability time by default; publication-delay sensitivity recorded in philippines_hotspot_coverage_audit.json.
